title: Fix malformed plugin hooks/hooks.json (Hook load failed at path [hooks]) + regression sensor
acceptance_criteria: hooks/hooks.json has a top-level `hooks` object key wrapping the event map (fixes the `at path ["hooks"]` undefined error).

The SessionStart entry has `matcher` as a sibling of a nested `hooks` array; the `{type:'command', command:'node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/context-monitor/repin.mjs"'}` object lives INSIDE that nested `hooks` array (not flattened).
The command string and the matcher `startup|resume|clear|compact` are preserved byte-for-byte from the original (only the structure changes).

A regression sensor (e.g. tests/plugin-hooks-format.spec.js) parses hooks/hooks.json and asserts: top-level `hooks` is an object; each event value is an array; each entry has a `hooks` array of `{type, command}` objects; and NO entry carries a flat top-level `command`/`type` sibling of `matcher`. The sensor must be non-vacuous (fail against the old flat shape).
npm run test:all is green including the new sensor; hooks/hooks.json is valid JSON.

comments.author: reviewer
comments.body:
APPROVE (FULL depth; clean first pass). Review depth = FULL; rubric inputs: CRITICAL user-blocking bug in shipped plugin config (hooks/hooks.json) fixed against an authoritative external schema, plus a MODIFIED existing sensor (laundering risk) + a new regression sensor. tests-after tier appropriate (config/data file + regression locks; ACs machine-verifiable so no UAT).

Root cause: hooks/hooks.json failed Claude Code hook validation (expected record, received undefined at path [hooks]) with two format defects vs the canonical schema (code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins.md 'Migrate hooks'): missing top-level `hooks` wrapper + type/command flattened as siblings of matcher instead of nested in a `hooks: []` array. It shipped undetected because tests/plugin-hooks-scaffold.spec.js (TASK-009) had ENCODED THE WRONG (flat) shape — the sensor locked in the bug.

Verified: (1) corrected hooks/hooks.json is an EXACT canonical match (top-level hooks object -> SessionStart array -> entry with matcher sibling of a nested hooks array holding {type:'command', command:'node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/context-monitor/repin.mjs"'}); diffed vs git show 68c67d0:hooks/hooks.json — command + matcher preserved byte-for-byte, only structure changed. (2) The scaffold-sensor rewrite is a LEGITIMATE correction not laundering — it now navigates hooks.SessionStart[].hooks[] faithful to the schema, preserves all 7 original tests' intent, and is non-vacuous (against the old flat file fileJson.hooks is undefined so the repin assertion fails). (3) New tests/plugin-hooks-format.spec.js is non-vacuous — dedicated negative tests run the validator against OLD_FLAT_SHAPE + a wrapped-but-flat variant asserting specific violation messages. (4) No over-reach — only 3 files changed; no dist rebuild (hooks.json not bundled; dist-parity green over 8 bundles).

Gate green: test:since -- 68c67d0 = 15 passed/2 files; npm test = 900 passed/2 skip; plugin-deps e2e 26; dist-parity 2. npm run test:all = 1640 passed/4 skipped.

Findings: 0 HIGH, 0 MEDIUM, 1 LOW (benign structural overlap between the two hooks specs — justified, both encode real regressions). Knowledge capture (TASK-105): not triggered by the rule (clean first-pass, no HIGH, no RC), but the orchestrator is capturing the wrong-format-sensor lesson separately given its value. Closed — ships in patch 0.14.1.
